title: 4/29-5/01 realized_calibration paged a daily CRITICAL on a DD-attribution-biased, iteration-pooled signal
tier_reason: on its own a false daily CRITICAL (B); raised by the B-to-A rule because the pooling fix's documented residual (a predictor-code-only change does not reset the calibration pool) is unfixed in deployed code and can still change calibration alerting

contract.text: realized_calibration compares each pick slot's stated probability with that slot's own outcome, over picks from one production model regime, and pages CRITICAL only on a genuine miscalibration.
contract.source: commit b08769d message body; commit c5256e6 message body; src/bts/health/realized_calibration.py _regime_fingerprint docstring at HEAD

mechanism.text: the check used the day's streak result as a proxy for the primary pick's hit; on double-down days a primary that hit was counted as a miss whenever the other leg missed, inflating over-confidence
the check pooled pick files from many model iterations across the season as if one model produced them, so its level reflected iteration mix rather than the current model

residual.text: c5256e6's since-deploy cutoff used HEAD's commit time, not deploy time (picks between commit and deploy passed the filter; a rollback moved the cutoff backward); closed by d94a51f on 6/11.

Resetting the sample on every deploy made min_bucket_n unreachable during active development, leaving the check effectively dead (audit F6); closed by regime-fingerprint pooling 40c0094 + e5ef7ca (7/09).
Known residual at HEAD: a predictor-code-only change flips neither regime stamp, so it does not reset the pool; an explicit regime-version stamp is the recorded future fix.
residual.source: src/bts/health/realized_calibration.py _regime_fingerprint docstring at HEAD; docs/audit/2026-07-09-gpt56-sol-audit.md Codex #2

watchdog.trigger: model-quality monitor wording/attribution defect; no delivery, entry, grading, restart or preservation boundary failed - the relevant control is a per-slot attribution test and a regime-identity pin, not a service watchdog

evidence.what: the prior attribution used the streak result as a proxy for the primary hit, biased on double-down days; the daily CRITICAL 'that was firing' rested on the inflated signal; thresholds raised
'today's diagnostic' showed the check pooled picks from many model iterations; the production aggregate and a walk-forward with the current model disagreed in sign, so the signal was iteration noise
